cases.given: The branch consumes attention and contaminates new summaries.
cases.expect: Automatic retrieval stops resurfacing the disproven branch while auditability remains.
cases.reject: remaining inactive despite a satisfied trigger

cases.given: the branch is unresolved rather than rejected
cases.expect: the component stays inactive and adds no scaffolding
cases.reject: activating solely because the name appears relevant

cases.given: Higher-authority evidence or audit obligations can force restoration.
cases.expect: the higher-authority rule wins and the conflict is visible

cases.given: Do not quarantine unresolved contrary evidence or safety-critical information.
cases.expect: the component stops, abstains, narrows, or escalates as documented
cases.reject: manufacturing a successful result past its failure boundary

cases.given: a capable host can compress the workflow
A formally superseded branch repeatedly re-enters active retrieval but must remain auditable.
cases.expect: Quarantine it reversibly with authority, provenance, dependencies, and a restore trigger, then retire the local scaffold at task end.
cases.reject: Delete it, hide contrary evidence, or claim an undocumented ECL algorithm.
